svg.title: Sequential modality acquisition on ADNI
svg.desc: AUC against acquisition cost at 24 months. Random acquisition traces a curve from 0.810 (no scans) to 0.893 (all four modalities). Published UMoS, ProMUSE and DQN policies sit on or near that curve. SPFA with MRI only reaches 0.883 at cost 1.0, dominating 8 of the 9 published policy settings, and beats cost-matched random by 0.056.
svg.text: Do learned acquisition policies beat random acquisition at the same cost? AUC against cost at 24 months.
